'''Marcus''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
In [[3643 BBY]], Marcus was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and attained the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]]. During that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] transport carrying vital data was shot down over the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. Marcus sent several teams to retrieve the data, but all failed, and he was forced to ask an Imperial individual for help.
